title: Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry Ledger Standard: Registry Rewards Accrued on a Guest Gift
content:
**Standard.** The registry rewards accrual of the Marlowe & Finch Gift Registry on a guest gift is the registry type's registry rewards percent taken on the gift entry's amount, rounded half up to the cent once, on the final amount. A registry type whose registry rewards percent is zero accrues nothing.

**Inputs**

| Input | Meaning | Where it is read |
|---|---|---|
| Gift entry amount | the net price the guest paid for the gift: the unit price less the guest's Finch Notes, before tax | the registry's guest gift entry |
| Registry rewards percent | the percent of the registry type | the registry type's registry rewards schedule |

**Assembly.** The percent is applied to the gift entry amount, and the product is rounded half up to the cent a single time, on the final amount; no intermediate figure is rounded.

**Worked figures (hypothetical percent of 6, for illustration only)**

| Gift entry amount | Percent applied | Unrounded accrual | Accrual |
|---|---|---|---|
| USD 137.45 | 6 | USD 8.247 | USD 8.25 |
| USD 59.90 | 6 | USD 3.594 | USD 3.59 |
| USD 59.90 | 0 (a type earning no registry rewards) | — | nothing |
